EU Considers Broad Corporate Tax Amid US Tech Giant Revenue Concerns

The European Commission is reportedly considering a wider corporate tax to generate revenue from large companies, including US tech giants. This move comes amid concerns about revenue generation and a potential "Trump tariff threat." The proposed levy would apply to all large corporations, rather than specifically targeting digital services groups. The aim is to capture revenue from major businesses operating within the EU.
